The employee was operating near a yellow sewage pump tank (pumper wagon) mounted on a two-wheel, single-axle trailer that was attached to a 1980 John Deere 4440 tractor via a tongue hitch and PTO shaft. The pump mounted at the front of the tank was PTO-driven. The pumper wagon lacked a manufacturer's label and was believed to be a homemade unit. While attempting…

events.title: Two employees work in silo and are overcome by vapors; two a…
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Employer: Heartland Tank Inc. Volga, SD. At 11:30 a.m. on September 7, 2024, Employee #1 and the owner were working inside a silage silo when they were overcome by hazardous vapors. A third employee entered the silo in an attempt to assist them. Employee #1 and the owner sustained fatal asphyxia injuries. The third employee was treated without hospitalization.

events.title: Employee falls from scissor lift causing head trauma leading…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Groeneweg Construction, Llc. Armour, SD. At 11:00 a.m. on December 29, 2023, Employee #1 was working for a framing contractor. Employee #1 was securing interior metal panels with a cordless drill to the interior wall of a pole barn while standing on a scissor lift. Employee #1 fell 7 feet from the scissor lift causing head trauma resulting in his fatality.

events.title: Employee is killed when crushed by forklift
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Protective Coating Specialists, Inc. Huron, SD. At 12:30 p.m. on November 21, 2023, an employee was using a forklift to load pallets onto a box truck. The employee attempted to back from the box truck to the dock, but the truck had rolled away, and the forklift fell to the ground. The employee was killed due to traumatic crushing injuries.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from roof while replacing steel r…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Dhd Construction, Inc. Quinn, SD. At 3:15 p.m. on September 13, 2023, an employee working as a carpenter for a construction contractor was removing and replacing damaged steel roof panels. The employee was removing fasteners to pull up damaged steel roofing when he fell 25 feet to ground. The employee died from multiple blunt force trauma from impact with the ground and broken roof purlin material.

events.title: Employee is killed when pinned by excavator
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: J & J Earthworks, Inc. Watertown, SD. At 9:00 a.m. on July 25, 2023, an employee was helping guide an excavator with an operator running it to dig out a payload that was stuck in gravel. The operator of the excavator struck the employee and pinned his body up against theglass of the payloader, crushing him. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed from blunt trauma in fall while framing r…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Core Framing, Llc. Sioux Falls, SD. At 3:30 p.m. on July 13, 2023, an employee working as a construction laborer for a framing contractor was framing a residential property. The employee fell from the upper roof area to the concrete floor below. He died from a head injury as aresult impact with the floor.

events.title: Employee is killed while lubricating machine rollers
events.description: 1 worker death. Sioux Falls, SD. At 2:15 p.m. on November 29, 2022, an employee was lubricating conveyor rollers with WD-40 in an energized robotic cell referred to as the iPal palletizer machine. There were no other similar machines in the facility. The employee was between the robot arm and south side of the conveyor when he unknowingly activated the photo eye located at the roller plane which senses when pallets are ready to be picked up. The motion of moving the can of WD-40 over the conveyor area satisfied the photo eye…

events.title: Employee is killed during explosion
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Amtec Corporation. Clear Lake, SD. At 2:00 p.m. on October 10, 2022, an employee was transporting energetic materials. During transport of the energetic materials, some materials detonatedcausing an explosion. The employee was killed during the explosion.

events.title: Employee is killed in work zone after run over by grader
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Oftedal Construction, Inc. Rapid City, SD. At 8:00 a.m. on June 29, 2022, an employee, who worked as a Gravel Checker, was walking behind a Caterpillar 14H Model 1411 Motor Grader. The employee was walking across the work zone travelling from the south traffic lane of a roadway to the northeast non-traffic side of the road. The coworker operating the graderbegan to back up and struck the employee running him over with the left two reartires and killing him. pelvic region, lower abdomen and legs, including multiple fractures and…

events.title: Employee is killed when crushed between lift and wall
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Big And Small Construction, Llc. Madison, SD. At 3:00 p.m. on November 13, 2021, an employee (Contractor) was installing housewrap with a pneumatic stapler over exterior sheathing on the first floor of a pre-fabricated house. The employee was found caught between the rails of the scissor lift and the house wall. The employee had been crushed and asphyxiated, which killed him.

events.title: Employee is killed in same level fall
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Suds And Duds, Inc. Dba Servall Uniforms. Rapid City, SD. At approximately 11:30 a.m. on May 20, 2021, an employee tripped and broke his neck from a same-level fall. The employee died from these injuries.

events.title: Employee is killed in same level fall
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: United States Postal Service. Sioux Falls, SD. At approximately 11:15 a.m. on May 10, 2021, an employee was walking up the driveway to a residence to deliver mail while sorting it in his hand The employee experienced a fall to the same level after possibly having his toes hit a piece of unlevel concrete. The employee was killed after sustaining these injuries.

events.title: Employee repairing sewer line is killed when trench collapse…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Nelsen Construction. Rapid City, SD. At 4:00 p.m. on December 21, 2020, Employee #1 and coworkers, employed by a water and sewer line construction company, were attempting to repair a residential sewer line that was back flowing. While they were in the trench they had dug, a trench wall collapsed. Employee #1 was caught in the collapsingmaterial and fatally crushed.

events.title: Employee is killed in grain engulfment
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Poinsett Hutterian Brethren, Inc. Estelline, SD. At 1:30 p.m. on September 11, 2020, Employee # 1 was working within a grain bin.He was pulled into the grain as it was being unloaded, from the bottom of the bin. He was killed in an engulfment in grain.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from roof of commercial building…
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Employer: Sands Drywall, Inc. Sioux Falls, SD. At 10:45 a.m. on May 12, 2020, an employee was assisting a coworker with steel decking placement on an overhang of a commercial building roof. The coworker, who was outside of the guard rail, was having trouble with placing a steel decking sheet. The employee jumped over the guardrail to assist the coworker. While standing on a gypsum board, the board collapsed and the employee fell sixty-five feet. The employee received multiple blunt force injuries and was killed.

events.title: Employee asphyxiates while working in oxygen deprived room
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Custom Genetic Solutions, Llc. Mitchell, SD. At 8:00 p.m. on November 20, 2019, an employee was topping off bull semen storage tanks with liquid nitrogen in a tank storage room when the nitrogen evaporated and displaced the oxygen in the room. The employee was killed from asphyxiation while working in a non-ventilated room.

events.title: Employee is struck by gate when pushed by cow and is killed…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Glacial Lakes Livestock, Inc. Watertown, SD. At 10:30 a.m. on August 14, 2019, an employee was standing in the sales arena by a gate through which the cow that was being shown was going to be lead. The employee was struck in the head by the gate when the cow slammed into it. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee falls from top of trailer, later dies
events.description: 2 worker deaths. Employer: Neiman Enterprises, Inc. Spearfish, SD. At 12:30 p.m. on November 9, 2018, an employee was applying a tarp to the lumberload on the 48 foot flatbed semi trailer. The employee either stepped or fell off the flatbed trailer, striking his head on the structural footing approximately six feet from the back of the truck. The employee sustained a broken neck and was initially hospitalized, placed on life support and later died of the injuries.

events.title: Employee is caught by excavation walls as they collapse and…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Olson Digging Service. Sioux Falls, SD. At 11;00 a.m. on May 3, 2018, an employee was working in an excavation digging for utility lines. The employee was trapped and buried by the excavation's walls when they collapsed and the employee was crushed and killed.

events.title: Employee suffers anaphylaxis and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Main & Main, Llc. Sioux Falls, SD. At 8:00 a.m. on Januray 10, 2018, Employee #1 was cleaning a room when he was stung by a bee. He experienced a severe reaction that constricted his airways. The employee suffered anaphylaxis and died.

events.title: Employee is crushed by round cornstalk bales
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Rock Valley Hay Auction Company. Hudson, SD. At 8:00 a.m. on January 8, 2018, an employee was unstrapping corn stalk bales that were positioned on a flatbed trailer. The first row of 1,100 pound bales of cornstalk fell off the trailer, crushing and killing the employee.

events.title: Fall to lower level
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Easi-Pour, Llc. Huron, SD. At 3:00 p.m. on October 28, 2017, Employees #1 and #2 were removing roofing panels from an enclosed building. Employee #1 fell through the paneling approximately 12 feet onto a overhead crane and was rescued with a forklift. Employee #1 suffered fractured ribs. Employee #2, owner, was removing tin panel and stepped backwards into the area tin, and fell 20 feet. Employee #2 was killed from a head injury.

events.title: Employee falls from truss and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Sorlien Electric, Inc. Hurley, SD. At 3:30 p.m. on December 29, 2016, an employee was running metal clad (MC) wiring the length of the pole barn. During this process, the employee exited thescissor-lift vertically, reaching the truss work of the pole barn, and then proceeded outside the footprint of the scissor lift, walking along 2x4s horizontally until he was a total of 16 feet away from the scissor lift's footprint. When the employee was walking out along the 2x4s, one of them snapped and gave way. The employee fell…

events.title: Employee dies in building collapse
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Hultgren Construction, Llc. Sioux Falls, SD. At 10:30 a.m. on December 2, 2016, an employee was removing an interior wall. While removing two load bearing walls of two buildings that were going to be made into one, the entire structure collapsed on top of the employee. The employee was killed by blunt force trauma to the chest along with asphyxia due to the amount of material that had trapped him in the rubble of the building.

events.title: Employee strikes head on end loader and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Hilltop Dairy. Elkton, SD. At 12:30 p.m. on September 30, 2016, an employee finished covering a sileage pile and was walking down the pile and either struck their head on the stairs of the front end loader, the front bucket, or in the process of getting a ride on the equipment and was killed.

events.title: Employee is struck and killed by a rough terrain forklift
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Steel Erectors, Inc. Sioux Falls, SD. At 9:45 a.m. on September 13, 2016, an employee was rigging steel I-beam to forklift. The forklift backed up, then moved forward and ran over the employee. The employee was killed from crushing injuries to the lower extremities. extremities.

At 6:30 a.m. on May 20, 2016, an employee was attempting to cut foam that had expanded out of the mold because they prematurely opened the mold. The foam started to expand and the doors to the machine were not able to be closed. The employee was electrocuted after contacting energized connections on the paddle of the hot wire cutter. events.title: Employee dies from combustible liquid fire and burns
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Bilfinger Westcon, Inc. Hudson, SD. At 6:00 a.m. on May 6, 2016, an employee was involved in the removal of a 4 inchline that was labeled non-condensable gas. As the pipe was being removed on one end, ethyl-alcohol spilled out of the pipe. The alcohol splashed on the employees pants in the process. The alcohol spilled out and ended up going through the scaffolding and through the grated flooring to the second floor. Twowelders were welding on the second floor and ignited a fire. events.title: Welder falls from exploding tank and is killed

At 2:30 p.m. on November 5, 2015, Employee #1, a welder employed by a welding company, was installing a catwalk between storage tanks that held soap stock. He was working on the top of a tank that measured 12 feet in diameter and 36 feet tall. As he welded the final connections for the catwalk, pressurized flammable vapors that had built up in the tank exploded. The roof of the tank was blown off, and Employee #1 was thrown from the tank.
